# Native binary redistribution inventory

Individually enumerated 226 PE/WebAssembly files in the privately tested revision-2 Windows payload. Each record in NATIVE_BINARIES.json includes SHA-256, file/product version, component/source version evidence, provenance, licence, required materials, PE imports and unresolved issues. No unclassified binary is accepted by the audit script.

**Native binary publication is on hold. Unknown exact source/build versions are marked explicitly; a PE resource version is not treated as a unique source revision.**

The earlier private Nautex-Native-Materials-0.3.14.zip contains 53 materials. The current third-party/native-materials.json identifies 54 materials for the private follow-up kit, including exact Chromium/Electron/Node sources, upstream PostgreSQL/GNU source archives, Sharp recipes and identified dependency sources. It is explicitly a partial native-materials kit, not a declaration that every binary-source obligation has been satisfied.

The earlier broad pthreads LGPL attribution is corrected to an explicit discrepancy requiring distributor clarification. Bundled PDF.js QCMS is identified from its actual MIT licence. Eight unused wxWidgets DLLs and the unused Sharp Wasm fallback are excluded from the revised Windows-only payload.
